scripts.deploy:dev: nuxt generate && AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan npx sls deploy --stage dev && AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan aws s3 sync .output/public/ s3://clichin-landing-assets-dev/ --delete && AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan aws cloudformation describe-stacks --region us-east-1 --stack-name clichin-landing-dev --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.deploy:prod: nuxt generate && AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan npx sls deploy --stage prod && AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan aws s3 sync .output/public/ s3://clichin-landing-assets-prod/ --delete && AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(AWS_PROFILE=mauloasan aws cloudformation describe-stacks --region us-east-1 --stack-name clichin-landing-prod --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
